comparison.objective: Load liquid bottles into an autoclave secondary tray with clearance from chamber walls, not tune machinery damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Bottle grasping, upright transport, spill avoidance, tray loading, and clearance management versus tool-mediated fine adjustment and force-controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Bottles remain in the secondary tray and clear of walls; body is empty and no spec versions or clearance/spill thresholds are available. Candidate requires energy-qualified cycles and lock-drift control.
comparison.reason: Liquid-container loading and containment do not test adjustable impact absorption.
